intro: Discovered among the embers of a dying campfire in Westfall, this blistered note leaves behind a cryptic and solitary clue. Its scorched message hints at a destination waiting elsewhere in the world, urging whoever finds it to seek out a 'twin land.'

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.
Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.
"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
